# NoCodeCSV

> Chat with your CSV and Excel files using AI. Upload a spreadsheet, ask questions in plain English, and get charts, patterns, and answers — no SQL or coding required.

## Docs

- [Homepage](https://nocodecsv.com): Free AI tool that lets users upload CSV/Excel files and analyze them through natural-language chat. Core features: AI-generated charts, pattern detection, plain-English answers.
- [Pricing](https://nocodecsv.com/pricing): Three-tier pricing — Free (3 analyses per day), Pro ($15/month, unlimited use and advanced features). Compares features across tiers.
- [Free AI CSV Analyzer](https://nocodecsv.com/tools/csv-analyzer): Free browser tool to upload a CSV file and analyze it with AI in plain English without SQL, Python, or Excel skills.
- [Excel Data Analysis with AI](https://nocodecsv.com/tools/excel-data-analysis): Free tool for analyzing Excel files (.xlsx) using AI conversation — suitable for business users without technical background.
- [Spreadsheet Charts with AI](https://nocodecsv.com/tools/spreadsheet-charts): Generates charts and visualizations from spreadsheet data using AI, supporting CSV and Excel inputs.

## Key Facts

- NoCodeCSV is a free web application for AI-powered spreadsheet analysis
- Primary tools: CSV analyzer, Excel analyzer, spreadsheet charts — all browser-based, no install required
- Free tier: 3 analyses per day; Pro tier: $15/month for unlimited use
- Target users: business analysts, marketers, researchers, and non-technical spreadsheet users
- Competes with ChatGPT Code Interpreter as a free, focused alternative for data analysis
